# Ulana Rey Photography

> The travel photography portfolio of Ulana Rey — also styled Ulana Rey PharmD,
> Dr. Ulana Rey, or Ulana Rey, Doctor of Pharmacy — a San Francisco–based
> photographer, biotech consultant, and healthcare executive.

## About Ulana Rey

Ulana Rey, PharmD, is a Doctor of Pharmacy (University of California, San
Francisco; residency at Stanford University) and a clinical
pharmacist by training. She is a biotech and pharma consultant, healthcare
executive, entrepreneur, and the Founder & CEO of MindLumina, a biotech
consulting and medical communications firm in San Francisco. She is also the
owner of Ulana Rey PharmD LLC. Outside her professional work she is a travel
photographer, hiker, runner, reader, and yoga practitioner. This site
collects her travel photography from Kauai, Santorini, Positano, Punta Mita,
Mykonos, Venice, Rome, Prague, Amsterdam, Lake Tahoe, Bora Bora, Turks and
Caicos, Milan, Jumby Bay, Hualalai, Lanai, and Florence.
